text: **Hint 1:** When choosing the best λ for regularization, consider the root-mean square error (RMSE) values obtained from the 5-fold cross-validation. The goal is to minimize the RMSE, as a lower RMSE indicates a better fit of the model to the data.\n\n**Hint 2:** Compare the average RMSE values for each λ across the $$5$$ folds. The λ with the lowest average RMSE is typically the best choice for regularization, as it suggests the model performs better on unseen data.
